rules.text: A valid Quebec fishing licence (sport-fishing permit) is required for anyone 12 and older to fish in Quebec, with some exceptions (e.g. a few designated free-fishing days per year). Non-residents pay a different fee than Quebec residents.

rules.source: regulations_overview.md#Bait rules (lines 62-85); quebec.ca "Use of bait" (https://www.quebec.ca/en/tourism-recreation-sport/sporting-and-outdoor-activities/sport-fishing/fishing-techniques/use-baits, last updated 2026-01-16)
rules.text: Since April 1, 2017, the use and possession of live bait fish (any fish, mollusc, crustacean, or marine animal used as bait -- this includes minnows and shiners), regardless of species, is prohibited throughout Quebec, including during winter fishing periods. Importing live or dead bait fish is also prohibited. Earthworms, leeches, insects, and frogs are not considered bait fish, so their use is permitted unless otherwise indicated.
